text:
Olivia: quick heads-up, onboarding m3x-small. pushed config and CI linter flagged an unknown field

Olivia: current config snippet I pushed:
```
{
  "model_name": "m3x-small",
  "weights_file": "gs://redwood-models/m3x-small/v1/weights.pt",
  "launch_cmd": "python serve.py",
  "tokenizer": {
    "type": "hf",
    "vocab": "gs://redwood-models/m3x-small/vocab.json",
    "pad_token": "<pad>"
  },
  "servable": true
}
```

config-lint-bot: config-lint FAILED for 1718901234: Unknown field `launch_cmd` at /launch_cmd. Schema suggestion: move to `runtime.exec` or `serve.exec` as `{\"cmd\": [\"python\", \"serve.py\"]}`. Also `weights_file` deprecated; use `weights_uri` (prefix) or `weights_manifest` (manifest json). See: https://wiki.redwood.ai/inference/config-schema#runtime

Sam: yep — schema v2025-02 added stricter field locations. `launch_cmd` used to be tolerated but now reserved. Replace with `runtime.exec` and make it a list for exec form. Example: "runtime.exec": { "cmd": ["python","serve.py"] }.

Desmond: tokenizer note: pad_token as string ok but better to include `pad_token_id`. For this model the HF vocab maps `<pad>` -> id 1. We've had truncation when id=0 used. Also the tokenizer file path should be a directory or HF repo path; the linter complains if it's a single blob without manifest.

Olivia: switching to:
```
"runtime.exec": { "cmd": ["python","serve.py"] },
"weights_uri": "gs://redwood-models/m3x-small/v1/",
"tokenizer": { "vocab": "gs://redwood-models/m3x-small/", "pad_token_id": "1" }
```

Sam: couple more checks: add `weights_sha256` for integrity (CI requires), and set `schema_version: \"2025-02\"` so the linter uses the right ruleset. If you enable kv-cache or streaming, add `runtime.capabilities: [\"kv-cache\",\"streaming\"]`.

Olivia: ran local lint: `tools/config-lint --path config.json` ->
```
WARNING: tokenizer path not reachable (403) -> gs://redwood-models/m3x-small/
ERROR: weights_sha256 missing
```

infra-bot: bucket `redwood-models` is restricted. To give CI access, add `roles/storage.objectViewer` to `ci-service-account@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com` or open a temporary read ACL. Filed request in #infra-access.

Olivia: pinging #infra-access and the infra team for a grant @infra-team :pray:

Desmond: also watch out for manifest vs prefix behavior: loader will treat `weights_uri` ending with `/` as prefix (sharded weights) and expect either `weights-0000.pt` pattern or a `manifest.json`. If you accidentally point to a single-file blob path, the runtime will try to stream shards and fail.

Sam: small nit: `pad_token_id` should be a number not a string in the final config. Linter will accept either initially but the onboarding job validates types strictly.

Olivia: infra granted viewer to the CI account. re-run local lint ->
```
tools/config-lint --path config.json
INFO: schema_version 2025-02 matched
INFO: runtime.exec present
INFO: weights_uri resolved -> gs://redwood-models/m3x-small/v1/
INFO: weights_sha256 present
WARNING: tokenizer dir scanned; pad_token_id resolved to 1
PASS: config-lint PASSED for 1718901234
```

Olivia: CI re-run queued. I'll push the manifest + sha and update PR. Planning a small canary on Dedicated for tomorrow morning (low traffic window).

Sam: nice — add `meta.owner: @olivia` and `rollout.canary: {"percent": 5, "duration": "1h"}` so ops knows to monitor.

Olivia: added metadata, CI green, PR ready to merge. Thanks for the rapid triage everyone :rocket:

config-lint-bot: config-lint PASSED for 1718901234

Olivia: merged and scheduled canary. will post results in the morning.
